'''Luis Escamilla''' of Madrid, Spain, attended [[DecipherCon 1999]] with [[Christian Escamilla]].<ref name="sun26">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000621164815/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SUN/sun26.html DecipherCon 1999 Sunday photo sun26], Decipher (Wayback 21 June 2000). Caption: "Christian and Luis Escamilla return to Madrid, Spain with lots of great memories of DecipherCon"</ref>
